name: The Taco Train
fail_reason: Solo 4 fotos reales unicas existen en su Google Business Profile (la propia ficha dice '5 Photos' pero 2 de las 5 URLs son byte-identicas, confirmado con md5sum). De esas 4, solo 2-3 son aptas para galeria (una toma de tacos buena, una de interior del truck buena, una pila de nachos aceptable); la restante es un plato de nachos a medio comer con fondo desordenado, no apta. No existe Instagram ni Facebook para rescatar mas fotos (WebSearch dirigido sin resultados, solo listados de directorio). Por debajo del minimo duro de 5 fotos reales de FORGE-BRIEF 0.b. Research NO degradado (gmaps_detail.js + gmaps_photocycle.js + gmaps_reviews.js corridos en vivo via Playwright).

reviews_verbatim.author: Julissa Balzan
reviews_verbatim.text: Today, I was on the hunt for authentic Mexican nachos for my son, he'd requested them for dinner, and Sundays are a no-cooking day! To my delight, I stumbled upon the Taco Train food truck, and let me tell you, it was a revelation.

reviews_verbatim.author: Marvin Feliz
reviews_verbatim.text: I've had birria tacos everywhere and these right here are the best I've had. Service was on point. The ingredients were fresh. This was a home run with my team. Catering for 50 people and it was seamless. Thank you!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Keitlyn Boza
reviews_verbatim.text: Amazing service, owner of the taco truck was very friendly, diligent, and provided us with the most care that anyone can ask for. Will definitely be coming back. You get exactly what you pay for and its all made with love.
